# Name.com
> Domain registration, DNS, email, hosting, and website tools for managing an online presence.

Name.com provides domain search and registration alongside DNS management, email, web hosting, website building, and related support resources for individuals and businesses.

## Core Products
- [Domain Names](https://www.name.com/domain-names): Search, register, transfer, and manage domain names across many TLDs.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.name.com/domain-transfer): Transfer existing domains to Name.com for centralized management and renewal.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.name.com/web-hosting): Shared hosting plans for launching and maintaining websites.
- [Email](https://www.name.com/email): Professional email services tied to custom domains.
- [Website Builder](https://www.name.com/website-builder): Build and publish websites using a hosted site creation tool.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.name.com/ssl): Secure websites with SSL certificates for encryption and trust.
- [DNS](https://www.name.com/dns): Manage DNS records and domain routing for websites and services.

## Domains
- [Domain Search](https://www.name.com/domain-names): Find available domains and compare registration options.
- [New Domain Extensions](https://www.name.com/new-domain-extensions): Explore newer TLD options beyond traditional domain extensions.
- [Premium Domains](https://www.name.com/premium-domains): Browse premium domain names with higher-value branding potential.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://www.name.com/whois-lookup): Look up domain registration details and ownership-related information.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.name.com/domain-transfer): Move domains from another registrar to Name.com.
- [Bulk Search](https://www.name.com/bulk-domain-search): Search availability for multiple domain names at once.

## Hosting and Site Services
- [Web Hosting](https://www.name.com/web-hosting): Hosting plans for websites, blogs, and small business projects.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.name.com/wordpress-hosting): Hosting tailored for WordPress-based websites and publishing workflows.
- [Website Builder](https://www.name.com/website-builder): Create websites without coding using templates and visual editing.
- [Email](https://www.name.com/email): Domain-based email for professional communication and branding.
- [Google Workspace](https://www.name.com/google-workspace): Business productivity email and collaboration tools from Google.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.name.com/ssl): Certificates for HTTPS encryption and browser trust indicators.

## Account and Domain Management
- [Login](https://www.name.com/account/login): Access your Name.com account and domain management dashboard.
- [My Account](https://www.name.com/account): Manage domains, billing, products, and account settings.
- [DNS Management](https://www.name.com/dns): Configure DNS zones, records, and routing behavior.
- [Domain Renewal](https://www.name.com/account/domains): Review and renew registered domains from your account.
- [Billing](https://www.name.com/account/billing): Manage payment methods, invoices, and subscription details.
- [Security Settings](https://www.name.com/account/settings): Update account preferences and security-related settings.

## Help Center
- [Support Center](https://www.name.com/support): Browse support resources for domains, hosting, email, and account issues.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.name.com/support/knowledgebase): Find help articles and troubleshooting documentation.
- [Contact Support](https://www.name.com/support/contact): Reach Name.com support for account and product assistance.
- [Domain Help](https://www.name.com/support/knowledgebase/domain-names): Learn about registration, transfers, renewals, and domain settings.
- [DNS Help](https://www.name.com/support/knowledgebase/dns): Understand DNS records, configuration, and troubleshooting steps.
- [Email Help](https://www.name.com/support/knowledgebase/email): Get setup and support information for email products.
- [Hosting Help](https://www.name.com/support/knowledgebase/hosting): Access hosting setup, management, and troubleshooting articles.
